discovery_notes: Follow-up 1 of B044; reuses keys from packets 402 and 105. 30 WebSearch calls, all snippet-level. New per-pin evidence: Best Friends Sep 2021 pairs, Alice Aug 2021 four designs, Frozen castle-only sixth pin, July 2021 OE line items, 20 years of pin trading items, Phantom Manor three priced pins, sidekick per-pin descriptions (maintainer may review 402 sidekick hold). Holds kept: Christmas booster 2020, Halloween trio, Christmas 2021 LE/OE, December Genie, Jungle Book Jive (reseller-only names). No instructional content seen.
